notes: IMPORTANT COLLISION: this "Sarwari" is a branch of the SUHRAWARDI order in Sindh, founded by Makhdoom Nooh. It is not the same as Sultan Bahu's "Sarwari Qadiri" (a branch of the Qadiri order). Two distinct branches share a name; they must not be merged into one node.

notes: parentOrder null: the Malamatiyya is not a branch of any of the five and the corpus does not place it under one. The overview calls him "the great Malamati Sufi" flatly; the History section hedges with "in spirit". See newOrdersNeeded.

claim: Shah Inayat Qadiri — belongs to — qadiriyya (branch: Qadri Shattari)

notes: multiple=true: the source names two silsilas. Only one of them (Qadiri) exists among the five; Shattari has no node, so parentOrders lists only qadiriyya and the Shattari half is carried by the branch string and newOrdersNeeded. Do not read the single parentOrder as the whole of his affiliation.
